calibrate.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) executes baseline calibration command on the sensor with the given ID.

co2.docs:
The CO₂ data from the sensor in parts per million (ppm). All options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [HC8 CO₂ Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/hc8#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for actions.

*See also: [HC8 CO₂ Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/hc8#configuration-variables)*

uart_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [UART Component](https://esphome.io/components/uart) if you want to use multiple UART buses.

*See also: [HC8 CO₂ Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/hc8#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [HC8 CO₂ Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/hc8#configuration-variables)*

warmup_time.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The sensor has a warmup period during which it returns inaccurate readings (e.g., 500ppm, 505ppm). This setting discards readings until the warmup time has elapsed (returning `NaN` during warmup). The datasheet specifies a 10-minute preheating time for full accuracy, with 90% accuracy achieved after 3 minutes. Empirical evidence shows that reasonable values are usually returned after about 1 minute. Defaults to `75s`.

*See also: [HC8 CO₂ Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/hc8#configuration-variables)*
